title: Derivation of L2 U2N Relay UE measurement results
text: A UE may be configured by network to derive NR sidelink measurement results of serving L2 Relay UE or candidate L2 U2N Relay UEs associated to the measurement objects configured in the measObjectRelay.
1 >  for each L2 U2N Relay UE measurement quantity to be derived:
2 >  derive the corresponding measurement quantity based on DMRS as described in TS 38.215 of the L2 U2N Relay UE associated to the NR sidelink frequency indicated in the concerned measObjectRelay;
2 >  apply layer 3 filtering as described in 5.5.3.2;
